[attribute-part-type]
=== `@part-type` Type of Part

Identifies the semantic type of an independent part of a standards document (<<element-sub-part,`<sub-part>`>>).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-sub-part,`<sub-part>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Names the type of semantic content included in the part or sub-part.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
